description: Hub for Workshop AI tasks: detects your AI clients and manages tasks through wai.
untrusted: Workshop AI runs wai and, later, AI clients in this folder, so it needs a trusted workspace.
cmd.initProject: Set up Workshop AI in this folder
cmd.addContext: Add to Workshop AI task context
welcome.noWai:
wai (the Workshop AI command line) or Python was not found.
[Locate wai](command:workshopAi.locateWai)
welcome.noFolder: Open a project folder to use Workshop AI.
welcome.noProject:
This folder is not set up for Workshop AI yet.
[Set up Workshop AI in this folder](command:workshopAi.initProject)
cfg.waiPath: Folder that contains the workshop_ai package (the Workshop AI product folder). Empty: the folder above this extension. Machine setting: a project cannot change it.
cfg.pythonPath: Python executable used to run wai. Empty: python.exe found on PATH. Machine setting.
cfg.infraPath: Shared infrastructure clone. Empty: WORKSHOP_AI_INFRA, else %USERPROFILE%\workshop\infra. Machine setting.
cfg.clients: AI clients you confirmed, with an optional executable path. Machine setting; never stored in a repository.
welcome.error:
wai could not read this folder's tasks. See the message, or the Workshop AI output channel.
[Refresh](command:workshopAi.refresh)
